source: Follows Unit 2 of SCERT Kerala Environmental Science Class III, Part 1 (2024), English medium. Explanations and questions are our own.

objectives.en: Say why people raise animals and name creatures around us
Notice how animals differ in size, colour, spots, horns and where they live
Group animals by how they move
Group animals by what they eat: herbivores, carnivores and omnivores
Describe the life of a butterfly
